full_title: An Offline-First Gamified Early Literacy Mobile Application Using the DepEd Marungko Approach
org_line: Group 56 · IT411 Capstone & Research 2 · CCS, CIT-University

solution.text: A phonics game where Lily the Tarsier teaches letter sounds, listens to the child, and cheers them on.
